تستغفرون (form X)
# تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ (tastaḡfirūna) /tas.taɣ.fi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# تُسْتَغْفَرُونَ (tustaḡfarūna) /tus.taɣ.fa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
